name: Turin
summary: Turin is defined by a matte Naqiu green marble top, its deep color and natural veining giving the piece a bold, luxurious presence. The bottom panel in matte black delivers a sharp, architectural contrast that refines the silhouette. The base is finished in elm veneer, introducing a subtle, warm texture that balances the darker elements. The combination of rich stone, sculpted contrast and refined wood gives Turin a confident, contemporary elegance. Naqiu green marble top (matte), bottom panel in matte black, MDF base with elm veneer in 114x81x38
